targets.note: Provisional. Derived from Mifflin-St Jeor at 170 lb / 74 in with a 1.6 activity multiplier, plus a ~250 kcal surplus. Replace with a trend-derived number after 14 days of logging.

streak_rules.note: Calories are deliberately not a streak condition. Photo estimates are too noisy to gate a streak on.

review_cadence.weekly: Sunday. Set next week's calorie and protein target from weight trend. Generate next week's MWF sessions plus two optional add-ins.
review_cadence.monthly: Progress summary email. InBody, tape, lift progression, adherence.
